designationHistory.indexText: Congress passed an act to establish the Bear River Migratory Bird Refuge at the mouth of the Bear River on Great Salt Lake.
designationHistory.note: Hoover's 1932 Proclamation 2012 quotes the act's title and approval date; the FWS plan gives 1928. Signer is the President in office on April 23, 1928. Hoover's 1932 proclamation added public lands to the refuge.
